page.overview:
Who is Acer?

Acer is a Lemon and one of Professor Z's top henchmen in Cars 2.

Much like his partner-in-crime, Grem, Acer is extremely sadistic and rude, the result of years of feeling like an outcast due to his odd appearance and weak performance on the road. Between him and Grem, Acer is dumber and clumsier, which is why he just simply stands next to Grem while he's the one who actually uses the electromagnetic pulse emitter on the World Grand Prix racers, in the movie.

In the movie, Acer did everything his partner Grem was doing although he only watched the crashes in the races whereas Grem was actually working the camera beam. In Japan, Acer, along with Grem, attacked Rod Redline in the bathroom who passed along information about the conspiracy plot to Mater. While Mater was still talking, Acer & his partner Grem shatters at the same time “GET OUT OF HERE!” Acer and Grem brought Rod to an abandoned warehouse where Rod was pumped with Allinol and Professor Z demonstrated the camera on him. Acer interrogated the agent and when he didn't fess up, watched as Grem killed him. Acer, along with Grem, arrived at Big Bentley in London where Mater, Holley Shiftwell and Finn McMissile were trapped and about to be crushed by the clocks gears. When Mater discovered the bomb on his air filter and when McQueen chased him down to see what the situation was, Grem and Acer try to kill the two friends only to Holley who swoops down from the sky to collide with them, making the two lemons flying into Ye Left Turn Inn and as a result, Acer along with Grem get beat up by cars bigger and stronger than them. Acer along with Grem and the other lemons were then arrested soon after.

Though Acer doesn't make any physical appearances in Cars 3, when Smokey and McQueen are in the latter's garage, there is a newspaper with an image of him falling into a lavatory services truck.
